description: Machine-readable declaration of how a harness adapter obtains decisions, per docs/FRAMEWORK.md. A manifest may never claim a decision surface it does not interrogate.

layer_attribution_required.description: Unknowns carry mandatory layer attribution (INV-004, Option A).

harness_version_pinned.description: Exact binary/config version measured. 'unpinned' is allowed ONLY for T3 survey manifests.

layer_vocabulary.description: Which of rules/approval/sandbox/effect the harness surface covers, and where layers are ambiguous.

would_resolve.description: What evidence would resolve this question.

invocation.description: Exact command/API used to obtain the harness's own decision, or 'none'.

reimplements_matching.description: True only if the adapter computes decisions from documented semantics (T2). A T2 adapter must set this true and label its output 'evaluation', never 'interrogation'.

decision_verbs.description: The harness's own decision vocabulary (e.g. allow/prompt/forbidden).

defaults.description: What the harness decides when no rule matches, stated as documented/observed, never inferred.

surface.description: Native config surface the adapter reads.

a_native_oracle.description: (a) Is there a deterministic offline way to obtain the harness's own decision? Answer with evidence or 'no'.

b_documented_semantics.description: (b) If (a) is no: are semantics documented precisely enough for T2?

c_surface_record.description: (c) If neither: the T3 surface record — surface, defaults, absence of oracle.

tier_evidence.description: One-line evidence for the tier assignment.

title: Boundary Framework — Adapter Manifest v1
